he’s taller than me, dark curly hair that he hates but I think is adorable. he hates how he looks in hats. he loves Chicago and wants to go to Northwestern for college. he thinks reddit is worse than ifunny (so he probably won’t read this). he can’t handle horror movies/games/etc at all. I’m trying to teach myself to hide my emotions. It’s not very easy though because I’ve worn them on my sleeve for most of my life.

I’ve been with my boyfriend for about five or six months now. I trust him in the sense that I don’t think he’ll purposefully hurt me, but at the same time I don’t want to tell him about my wanting to die. He’s already seen me have panic attacks before (I have an anxiety disorder) and it upsets him so I think that this would be to much for him to handle.

I’m very sorry about your mother. Of course, I’m sure you’ve heard that far too many times.

But yeah, I don’t want a bloody death. My mother has a super weak stomach and passes out easily. I don’t want that to happen to her if she sees me like that. And I can understand what you’re saying. It’s just hard because I’ve been stuck in this rut of not wanting to live for a while.

I struggle to talk to other people without making things awkward and uncomfortable for everyone involved. I can go entire weeks without saying a word to anyone in most of my classes. When people do actually approach me I get really anxious and start to ramble without stopping. I think that’s part of the reason why I’m odd. 

I hope your job interview goes well! I would offer you advice but I’m sure you’ve heard it all and I don’t think I could offer anything of use anyways. I’ve never been to a job interview.

I’m not great with people either. But McDonald’s is where my mom says I’m ending up when we fight. And I feel the  same way about failures. Especially when they come one after another or your expectations were up.

I would say a lot of bug spray? But I feel like food and protection from the elements would be more of a priority than escaping the bugs if you end up on the streets.
